summary_en: 490,500 shares (20.06% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired by August 4, 2026 via off-market OTC trade. Acquisition price not disclosed. Concurrent capital-business partnership with Heuristic Corp (3003); Mitsui Metals (5706) will transfer its Nakabohtec stake to Heuristic; technical partnership with Mitsui Metals to be terminated.
title_en: Notice of Capital and Business Partnership Agreement with Heuristic Corp, Termination of Capital and Technology Partnership with Mitsui Metals, Share Acquisition, and Changes in Principal Shareholders and Related Companies
translation_en_brief: Nakabohtec announced on August 3, 2026, that its board approved (1) entry into a capital and business partnership with Heuristic Corp (3003), (2) termination of its technical partnership with Mitsui Metals (5706), and (3) acquisition of 490,500 of its own shares. The shares represent 20.06% of Nakabohtec's voting rights as of March 31, 2026 (computed on an ex-treasury denominator of 24,446 voting units). Mitsui Metals, Nakabohtec's principal shareholder and related company, has agreed to transfer those shares to Heuristic via off-market OTC trade by August 4, 2026. The acquisition price is not disclosed in the filing. The partnership aims to combine Nakabohtec's corrosion-protection technology, customer base, and know-how with Heuristic's real-estate network, capital, and M&A expertise to develop joint infrastructure-related business opportunities. No specific repurchase budget, price ceiling, or execution window (other than the August 4 deadline) is stated.
